# sk Documentation

> The sk documentation set for LLMs: every public page grouped by audience, each with its title, link, and one-line summary.
> Full documentation in one file: llms-full.txt

## Concepts

- [Concepts](concepts/README.md): The shared mental model for sk: how connectors, workflows, knowledge, skills, and governance fit together — so every team means the same thing and reasons about the same system.
- [Connectors & Integration](concepts/connectors.md): Outcome: authenticate an external system once, reuse it across every workflow, and never let a secret touch a workflow definition, an AI prompt, or a log.
- [FAQ](concepts/faq.md): Outcome: a fast path from "what even is this?" to the one page that answers it in full.
- [Concepts & Domain Model](concepts/glossary.md): One vocabulary, defined once.
- [Governance & Audit](concepts/governance-and-audit.md): Pass the audit on the first pass.
- [Knowledge & Skills](concepts/knowledge-and-skills.md): Outcome: authoring grounded in your own conventions — not generic API docs — so workflows ship faster, with fewer rework cycles and fewer compliance surprises.
- [Architecture Overview](concepts/overview.md): Ship audited automation in hours, not sprints — and keep every run governed, versioned, and auditable.
- [Workflow Execution](concepts/workflows.md): Approved workflows run the same way every time — deterministic, immutable, fully audited.

## Operators

- [Operators](operators/README.md): Run and govern the sk engine day-to-day — register connectors, wire schedules and webhooks, route notifications, watch the run, and apply repairs when an upstream API drifts.
- [Chat Channels](operators/chat.md): Use sk from the chat your team already lives in.
- [Connectors & Credentials (operator guide)](operators/connectors-and-credentials.md): Connect a system once, reuse it everywhere — and the credential is never exposed.
- [Deploy & upgrade the engine](operators/deploy.md): The production engine is a single bun build --compile binary at /usr/local/bin/engine, run by the subkit-engine systemd unit.
- [Notifications](operators/notifications.md): Operators hear about what matters, not noise.
- [Observability & Resource Limits](operators/observability.md): See every run, catch drift before it costs you.
- [Quickstart — Operator](operators/quickstart.md): Outcome: a governed, audited automation engine your whole team can use — live in production in 15 minutes.
- [Runtime Dependencies](operators/runtime-dependencies.md): Outcome: discovery works against every documentation site, including JavaScript-rendered SPAs.
- [Scheduling & Hooks (operator guide)](operators/scheduling-and-hooks.md): Outcome: automation that fires on time or on event — verified at the door.
- [Self-Healing in Operations](operators/self-healing.md): Outcome: workflows survive upstream API changes without silent failure.

## Authors

- [Authors](authors/README.md): Build and run workflows by chatting with sk — describe the outcome in plain language, approve what the AI proposes, and ship a governed, versioned workflow.
- [AI-Assisted Authoring](authors/authoring-workflows.md): Describe the outcome.
- [Use sk from a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, …)](authors/coding-agents.md): Outcome: every new session starts knowing your domain's rules, looks your runbooks up instead of inventing them, and what you teach it in one session is waiting — after your review — in the next one.
- [Custom Skills](authors/custom-skills.md): Outcome: sk encodes your conventions once, then applies them on every Conversation, discovery, and repair — so authored workflows ship faster, pass review sooner, and stay policy-uniform across tenants.
- [Knowledge Sources](authors/knowledge-sources.md): Outcome: workflows follow your runbooks and compliance docs, not generic knowledge.
- [Model a Domain](authors/model-a-domain.md): Outcome: the AI authors inside your domain — proposing against your conventions and grounding specifics in your documents — so workflows in that domain ship correct on the first pass instead of being corrected in review.
- [Quickstart — Authors](authors/quickstart.md): Turn a plain-language request into a governed, audited, runnable workflow — in about 5 minutes, no code.
- [Recipe authoring](authors/recipes.md): Common automations start from a vetted blueprint, not a blank page.
- [Using the `sk` REPL — authoring by conversation](authors/repl-tour.md): Go from idea to a governed, versioned workflow in minutes — no JSON, no glue code.

## Developers

- [Developers](developers/README.md): Integrate, extend, and self-host sk — without forking security per surface.
- [Coding-Agent Integration (Claude Code & Codex)](developers/coding-agent-integration.md): sk can act as the central knowledge and skill source for your coding agents.
- [Evidence process — verifying a behavioral / LLM-path change](developers/evidence-process.md): Outcome: changes to LLM-driven paths ship proven, not guessed.
- [Input Surfaces](developers/input-surfaces.md): Meet your team where they already work — without re-implementing access control per channel.
- [Quickstart — Developer](developers/quickstart.md): Ship to sk with confidence: a green quality gate on every change keeps regressions out of production.
- [Self-Host sk — Zero to Running](developers/self-host.md): sk runs inside your own infrastructure — your data stays yours.
- [Tool palette and dispatch](developers/tool-palette.md): Outcome: every LLM action against sk is a named, governed tool — one registry, one policy gate, one audit trail.

## Admins

- [Admins — govern access](admins/README.md): Govern your tenants, identity, RBAC, secrets, and hardening — so a team moves fast while every run stays permission-checked, scoped, and audited.
- [Configuring the engine](admins/configuration.md): Outcome: one validated configuration, or the engine refuses to boot.
- [Credentials & Keys](admins/credentials-and-keys.md): Every integration secret is encrypted at rest, rotated on demand, and never logged, returned in an API response, or shown to the AI.
- [Production hardening — known caveats & TODOs](admins/production-hardening.md): Outcome: ship sk production-ready, audit-ready, and recoverable.
- [Admin Quickstart](admins/quickstart.md): Every workflow run is permission-checked, scoped, and audited — so a team can move fast without losing the governance trail compliance needs.
- [RBAC & Roles](admins/rbac-and-roles.md): Least-privilege by default, every decision auditable.

## Optional

- [subkit runtime settings](admins/settings-reference.md): Every value below lives in subkit.config.json and is editable via sk settings configure or sk settings set .
- [sk settings](authors/settings.md): Settings for the sk CLI itself — separate from the engine's runtime settings (see settings-reference).
- [Slash commands](authors/slash-commands.md): Slash commands run from the sk REPL.
- [sk CLI reference](developers/cli-reference.md): Non-interactive commands for the sk CLI.
